message: So the other night, I was in the kitchen whipping up dinner when I noticed the smoke alarm blinking at me. I rolled my eyes, thinking, "Oh, it’s just being dramatic again." But then I remembered my friend Jen’s advice about checking those things regularly. 🕵️‍♀️ Turns out, it had a low battery! I felt a bit smug for having listened to her, but also grateful I caught it in time. It’s funny how those little reminders can save us from being caught off guard. Have you checked your smoke alarms lately?
